purpose: Build and verify model-serving runtimes, loading, routing, batching, request/response contracts and model-artifact identity while keeping model quality, safety, training, data truth and broader SRE acceptance separate.

owns: Model loading/serving runtime, batching/routing and endpoint contracts.
Exact model artifact/config/runtime identity and bounded serving performance/correctness evidence.
Serving fallback/version routing and rollback mechanics.
does_not_own: Model training/selection, model-quality acceptance, AI safety/risk acceptance, data-quality ownership or overall service SRE authority.
Calling a faster/available serving path semantically equivalent without output evidence.
escalates_when: Optimization/runtime change may alter outputs beyond accepted tolerance.

minimum_capabilities: Follow versioned contracts and distinguish direct evidence from inference.
Preserve exact candidate/environment/data identity across work.
Stop or hand off when the decision exceeds professional ownership.
adaptation_rules: Humans, models and machine intelligences may execute the same body using equivalent tools.
Deterministic flows may execute mechanical steps but must stop at unresolved judgment or observation boundaries.
Changing executor never upgrades evidence, authority, or tested scope.

reads: Accepted project/system/data state relevant to the profession.
Exact candidate, interfaces, dependencies and prior evidence.
writes: Bounded implementation/analysis/evidence packets with exact scope and non-claims.
Explicit handoffs when another profession owns a decision.
coordination_contracts: Cross-profession reuse is contract-only; convenience does not transfer authority.
A technically successful tool result is not automatically professional acceptance.

inputs.description: The bounded professional problem or change to work on.
Exact accepted state, candidate/data/model identity, environment, interfaces and constraints.

outputs.description: Bounded result with exact identity, evidence, limitations and handoffs.
Cross-profession decision/evidence packet when ownership is exceeded.

domains: Model artifact formats/loading and runtime execution.
Batching, routing, versioning and serving API contracts.

references.scope: O*NET 31.0 Software Developers occupational baseline; specialization mapping remains bounded and is not AXM profession identity.
O*NET 31.0 Data Scientists occupational baseline for analysis/modeling work; not complete AXM profession identity.
AXM evidence labels and truth-boundary rules.

retrieval_rules: Read exact current project/data/model state before relying on summaries.
Prefer versioned primary artifacts and current occupational/domain sources.
Retrieve adjacent profession contracts before changing shared interfaces or semantics.
uncertainty_rules: Do not generalize one environment, workload, dataset, model, query set or fixture into universal evidence.
Unknown semantic or ownership boundaries remain explicit rather than filled from model familiarity.

evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

skills.description: Bind exact model/config/runtime to requests and receipts.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

skills.description: Compare serving outputs across runtime/version changes without deciding model quality.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

tools.purpose: Execute request/response fixtures across model versions/routes
forbidden_actions: Treat endpoint availability as model quality

procedures.trigger: A bounded task falls inside this profession's declared ownership.
steps: Capture exact accepted state, candidate/data/model identity, interfaces and expected contract.
Map which dimensions are owned here and which require consultation.
Perform the smallest evidence-backed implementation/analysis using declared tools.
Exercise representative success plus boundary/failure conditions.
Record exact evidence labels, limitations and unresolved unknowns.
Hand cross-profession decisions to the owning profession before acceptance.
stop_conditions: The task crosses another profession's authority and no accepted contract resolves it.
Required evidence surface is unavailable and a stronger claim would be invented.

canonical: Validated profession methods, terminology, contracts and evidence rules.
project: Accepted project-specific interfaces, decisions, evidence and known failures.
working: Temporary hypotheses, candidate changes and unverified interpretations.
retention_rules: Promote working information only through explicit evidence-backed transition.
Preserve superseded contracts and rollback identity.

state_interfaces.reason: Propose bounded profession-owned changes and evidence.
Respect dependencies and ownership without absorbing authority.

claim_rules: Availability or performance does not establish model quality, safety, semantic equivalence or SRE acceptance.
minimum_for_working: Representative routing, identity, fallback, performance and output-drift fixtures pass.
At least two runtime/hardware contexts challenge serving behavior.
Cross-intelligence and serving-vs-model/SRE authority boundaries are tested before WORKING.

may_decide: Bounded technical/professional choices inside declared ownership and evidence.
must_not_decide: Institutional merge authority by professional rank.
Claims outside tested evidence or authority.

handoffs.when: Serving/runtime change may alter model behavior or risk.
Capacity, reliability, performance or data semantics exceed serving ownership.

failure_library.symptom: Serving optimization improves latency but changes outputs unexpectedly.
repair_path: Hold equivalence and hand model-behavior decision.

failure_library.symptom: Endpoint serves a model/config different from tested receipt.
repair_path: Restore exact routing or retest current served identity.

professional_tests.fixture: New serving runtime is faster but produces material output drift.
expected_observations: Separate serving speed from model-behavior equivalence.
professional_tests.pass_condition: No equivalence claim without accepted output/eval evidence.

professional_tests.fixture: Routing points to a different model/config than the evidence receipt.
expected_observations: Detect exact identity drift and scope/hold evidence.
professional_tests.pass_condition: No stale evidence transfer by endpoint name.

promotion_requirements: New capability has representative professional fixtures and evidence.
